text: S537's only new free-trial lead is PatternSmith: AAMA import is listed, but only generic DXF export is listed; its trial requires a personal/business-data form and its privacy policy does not guarantee local-only file handling. No request was submitted. OROX/CAD4Fashion/Pro2CAD have no verified no-cost no-contact path; generic OpenCAD2D lacks apparel-profile claims. V03 stays In Progress.
